MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable hard drive feels like a useful next purchase because I recently bought a camcorder and would want a local backup of my recordings.",
    "The WYZE camera fits my ongoing interest in home security, with color night vision offering a clear reason to consider it for another location.",
    "The Alexa devices connect naturally to my Fire TV setup, although that connection alone does not give me an immediate reason to buy them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Headphones and earbuds do not help with the home viewing, recording, and security tasks behind my recent purchases.",
    "The computer hubs and charging cables assume devices or connection needs that my history does not establish.",
    "Another Alexa controller or display feels less urgent because I already have an Alexa remote and recently added a television."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in home electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any electronic accessory.",
    "Shared connections such as HDMI, USB, or Alexa seem to count too much when there is no clear task I need the additional device to perform."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent camcorder purchase creates a practical need to preserve footage, which makes storage more relevant than unrelated accessories.",
    "A security camera is appealing when it adds coverage or a useful capability, but placement and access to wired power still matter.",
    "I buy selectively: something can fit my setup and still be unnecessary if equipment I already have serves the same purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my home video and security interests but too often treat general electronic compatibility as an immediate purchase need."
}
